deviations.what: Money in ↓ and Money out ↑ arrows are drawn in full ink where the frame tints them green and red (var(--in) / var(--out))
deviations.reason: The frame's tints are the credit/debit tokens, which 07 §1 rule 3 🔒 keeps for amounts only; icons may take the success/warning/info/danger family, but none of those means a direction (danger is 'never reads as money out'). A frame never overrides a 🔒 line, so the arrows stay off the money tokens until the owner rules; the word under each arrow carries the direction
deviations.authority: 07 §1 rule 3 🔒; ADR 2026-09-05f §H1; CLAUDE.md § Precedence; ⚠️ SPEC home_cards.dart (open P1A)
